notes: s003 ὁ is `unrepresented` under rule 31's closing clause: it stands before a prepositional phrase and the ASV supplies no relative clause at all.
s006 εὐσχήμων → 'of honorable estate' heads on 'estate' on rule 104's εὐ-compound pattern; heading on 'honorable' is the competing reading and is named in the unit note.
s015 and s026 are `unrepresented` under rules 21 and 23, the ASV giving those nouns no determiner, so the case preposition stays with the noun.
